title: Edits to an n8n workflow are saved but the production webhook still runs the old version
symptoms: Production executions show the previous node settings
Fix works in a manual test, not in live runs
Schedule trigger keeps the old interval after saving
cause: From 2.0 the active toggle is replaced by Publish, and autosaved edits stay in draft. Production webhooks, forms, schedules and app triggers keep running the last published version.
fix: Click Publish after editing, or publish from the CLI with publish:workflow in deploy scripts.
affected: n8n 2.0 and later, self-hosted and Cloud
